<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Simultaneous Elections:</strong> The NDA government is reportedly planning to hold joint Vidhan Sabha elections for 22 states and Union Territories alongside the 2029 Lok Sabha polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPQks0a28xQnFlTGt0TlFBUjloNDY0MG4yNElIRXpZV2pZV2FPMU9YZkxDVENibWdEMEFMbFQzbHhwSEwzLVN2eVR1WGxxN1hkejhWZmJ6SEVlZjMxXzhzWHRBWWc0cXplOTJsNjZ2dHRIVF8tYkozaTRtdFZVWDloQVh2RHBFeDlBR1RpWFI3WkNMc1F3UmdaYjVBc0xNZjhzeEdUbHR5dkE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQNk1BNFpMNmVkQTVscmFNX1JQY0o0UkNHYWQtbmFyZGhUMWxSeTgyRURTYUVRTURXSHd3QlJFRkpZRUV0bkVlTGpYZGVJU2VXVkwzWk9wdGdmS3pyT2l5VGRTUnBQYWttTFIyQWo3cDdaaDRuT3pVRmFJeldVMldLelZ0MUhGTHZMMkNYbEU4WnhSRmhwTkpQTG9QUkl6Y3duQmE4UUl5YjlpaXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
